cost_allocation: Every full umbrella is paid once within its topic, regardless of overlap with another topic. New_Code is a single complete common artifact and is paid once at acquisition. conditions: Full-source lengths are compared under the existing principal-result contracts, not all-assertions equivalence.
L079 semilinear census/Conjecture11 and L021 final PGL question remain excluded from mathematical recovery; their printed source text is still counted.
All-prime constructions are proved in A3. Validation contains only diagnostic samples and false-weakening controls; every literal correction witness remains required.
Some program-cost change comes from separating diagnostics; report the validation-inclusive sensitivity alongside primary known costs.
Source and replacement use the same declared external classical library; unknown underlying proof costs are not zero.
No historical novelty, new solved question, additional source credit, minimum-description-length or repeated sawtooth claim.
premeasurement_disclosure: Old two-application factors and complete manuscript contents were known. This is a fixed-ruler retrospective audit, not a blinded experiment. New factors have not been evaluated before this boundary freeze.
